seo.title: Featured Writings from Our Partners — EmpowerHer Initiative
seo.description: Read featured writings from Afghan girls published through EmpowerHer's partner platforms — NSHSS and Amplify Afghan Women.

header.heading: Featured Writings from Our Partners
header.lede: Afghan girls and women sharing their stories, experiences, and perspectives with the world through our network of publication partners.

writings.title: The Classroom I Carry With Me
writings.description: A seventeen-year-old from Kabul writes about teaching her younger sisters at home after the schools closed their doors.

writings.title: Letters to the Girl I Used to Be
writings.description: Reflections on memory, loss, and the quiet courage of continuing to learn in secret.

writings.title: What the River Taught Me About Patience
writings.description: An essay on finding hope in the small rituals of a home that has become a school.

writings.title: A Notebook Full of Tomorrows
writings.description: One student describes the science lessons she records at night, dreaming of a laboratory she has never seen.

writings.title: The Weight and the Wings of Words
writings.description: A young poet on why she keeps writing even when no one outside her family will read the pages.

writings.title: Between Two Windows
writings.description: A meditation on the view from home and the wider world she is determined to reach.

writings.title: We Are Still Here
writings.description: A defiant, tender account of building an underground network of girls who refuse to stop studying.

writings.title: My Mother's Hands, My Own Voice
writings.description: A daughter traces the line between the generation that raised her and the future she intends to write.

writings.title: The Color of Resilience
writings.description: On painting, protest, and the small acts of beauty that keep a community together.
